title: Validate and normalize a signup request
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It delivers validateSignup in JavaScript, while the brief asks for a Python function validate_signup.
Anchored ASCII patterns implement every username, email and password rule, booleans and floats are age_type, and the normalized user omits the password.
The username pattern drops the must-start-with-a-letter rule, so "_ada" and "9lives" are accepted instead of username_format.
Set comparisons against ASCII character sets implement each rule exactly, and the result has the required shape with the email normalized and the password left out.
